role: post hoc descriptive initial-design coverage on already-observed 2024 development summaries; no optimizer, verifier or independent confirmation
registration_context: All 2024 population outcomes and complete 2023 source archive observed; source-first and structural designs already frozen. This is a retrospective diagnostic, not a prospective outcome-blind registration.
coverage: For each frozen ten-point design, count actual candidates with at least 70/73 successes in each fixed sample. Retain all original success counts, source first center and medoid. No new score-based selection, candidate changes, certificate, loss imputation or significance test.
accounting: Zero new physical calls. Source archive actually paid 44,968 controller evaluations including the 32 pilot cells. Saved full target classification is diagnostic evidence, not a free prospective simulator or deployment cost. No hypothetical amortization.
limitations: Both source and development outcomes previously observed; overlapping windows in one market. Coverage is not certified deployment, objective improvement, compute efficiency, independent confirmation or OR readiness. The finite full augmented objective atlas remains unconnected on failed paths.
